q: This interface also widens the attack surface, letting malicious shell commands hide within natural-language skill files.
r: Include: agent skills files (context mechanism) evaluated with two coding agents over 5,629 runs; security angle, but group (b) is not narrowed by EC6.

q: We propose GSE, a globalized skill evolution framework that formulates skill evolution as a global optimization problem over an interconnected and reusable skill bank.
r: Include: skills for software engineering agents evaluated with cost analysis and ablation; group (b) is not narrowed.

q: This paper studies token amplification through skill injection
r: Include: injected agent skills measured on token cost across real coding agents; group (b), relevant to cost metrics (RQ2, RQ4).

q: The contribution is a bounded application of established optimization to selecting assurance context for a supplied software-change task
r: IC1: formal evidence-selection method with synthetic benchmark; no coding agent is run and agent benefit is left open, so not SDD, context files or agent evaluation.

q: We define state-conditioned minimal sufficient evidence recovery, the task of retrieving what an agent’s next decision still lacks.
r: EC6: benchmark of code evidence retrieval for coding agents (code search/understanding), not code development and not a context-file mechanism.

q: We construct VibeMemBench, a benchmark whose 3,634 trajectories from the target repositories supply a persistent memory substrate
r: Include: benchmark and matched intervention protocol for persistent memory systems with coding agents on executable repository tasks; group (b).

q: we propose StateTape, a context maintenance framework towards the trade-off between the cost and quality of the context
r: EC5: main contribution is a new runtime context-maintenance technique tested on existing benchmarks (SWE-EVO, SWE-bench Pro); not a context-file mechanism.

q: We introduce XRepoSkill, a trajectory-based skill learning approach that discovers candidate rules from behavioral divergences between successful and failed attempts
r: Include: learned skills (rule/instruction files) for software engineering agents, evaluated on resolve rate; group (b) is not narrowed by EC6 despite issue repair.

q: We introduced MemTrace, a state-consistent memory system for long-horizon coding agents
r: Include: memory mechanism for coding agents evaluated on three long-horizon benchmarks and two harnesses; group (b), memory.

q: We present the first empirical study of such conflicts.
r: Include: controlled empirical study of co-installed agent skills (SKILL.md) in Claude Code, 6,368 runs over three models; group (b).
